# CANDIDATE: GAP_FADE_WEAK_CLOSE_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-09-11
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A gap up that closes weakly in its first 5‑minute bar often fades, providing a short edge. Weak close is defined as the bar closing in the lower 30% of its range with below-average volume. This opposes GAP_AND_GO which trades gap continuations; we fade gaps on weak close and low volume.

## Mechanism

Entry: If the open gaps up > 0.3*ATR(14) above the prior close AND the first 5‑minute bar closes in the lower 30% of its range (close‑low < 0.3×(high‑low)) AND volume is below the average volume of the preceding 5 bars, go short at the next bar open. Exit: Chart‑stop at the gap high (or high of the entry bar), TP1 at 1.5R, runner trail using a chandelier exit (ATR×3). Regime filter: VIX < 22 and time between 09:30‑10:00 EST.
